mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_campaign ( notification_type, title, body, deep_link, topic, dedupe_key, visible_from, visible_until ) VALUES ( #{notificationType}, #{title}, #{body}, #{deepLink}, #{topic}, #{dedupeKey}, #{visibleFrom}, #{visibleUntil} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE campaign_id = LAST_INSERT_ID(campaign_id), title = VALUES(title), body = VALUES(body), deep_link = VALUES(deep_link), topic = VALUES(topic), visible_from = VALUES(visible_from), visible_until = VALUES(visible_until)
mapper.select: SELECT notification_id, user_id, notification_type, title, body, deep_link, dedupe_key, is_read AS `read`, push_status, push_attempts, sent_at, read_at, created_at, updated_at FROM notification_history WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId}

SELECT campaign_id, notification_type, title, body, deep_link, topic, dedupe_key, push_status, push_attempts, visible_from, visible_until, sent_at, created_at, updated_at FROM notification_campaign WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = FALSE) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification_campaign campaign WHERE campaign.visible_from <= #{now} AND (campaign.visible_until IS NULL OR campaign.visible_until >= #{now}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notification_campaign_receipt receipt WHERE receipt.campaign_id = campaign.campaign_id AND receipt.user_id = #{userId} ))
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_history SET is_read = TRUE, read_at = COALESCE(read_at, #{readAt}) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT user.user_id FROM users user WHERE user.user_id > #{lastUserId} AND user.is_withdrawn = FALSE AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM device_token token WHERE token.user_id = user.user_id AND token.is_active = TRUE ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mission WHERE mission.is_active = TRUE AND ( ( mission.mission_category IN ('DAILY', 'RECOMMENDED') AND mission.action_type IN ( 'VIEW_MARKET_REPORT', 'VIEW_TRANSACTION_HISTORY', 'VIEW_DEPOSIT_PRODUCT', 'VIEW_REBALANCING', 'RUN_WHAT_IF_SIMULATION' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_mission_completion completion WHERE completion.user_id = user.user_id AND completion.mission_id = mission.mission_id AND completion.completion_date = CURDATE() ) ) OR ( mission.mission_category = 'ONE_TIME' AND mission.action_type IN ( 'VIEW_MARKET_REPORT', 'VIEW_TRANSACTION_HISTORY', 'VIEW_DEPOSIT_PRODUCT', 'VIEW_REBALANCING', 'RUN_WHAT_IF_SIMULATION' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_mission_completion completion WHERE completion.user_id = user.user_id AND completion.mission_id = mission.mission_id ) ) OR ( mission.mission_category = 'EVENT' AND ( (mission.trigger_type = 'DAYS_TO_DISCHARGE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM soldier_profile profile WHERE profile.user_id = user.user_id AND DATEDIFF(profile.discharge_date, CURDATE()) = mission.trigger_value )) OR (mission.trigger_type = 'LEAVE_SCHEDULED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM leave_mode leave_status WHERE leave_status.user_id = user.user_id AND leave_status.is_leave_mode_enabled = TRUE AND CURDATE() BETWEEN leave_status.start_date AND leave_status.end_date )) OR (mission.trigger_type = 'PAYDAY' AND DAY(CURDATE()) = mission.trigger_value) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_mission_completion completion WHERE completion.user_id = user.user_id AND completion.mission_id = mission.mission_id AND completion.completion_date = CURDATE() ) ) ) ) ORDER BY user.user_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT user.user_id FROM users user INNER JOIN recurring_investment_plan plan ON plan.user_id = user.user_id WHERE user.user_id > #{lastUserId} AND user.is_withdrawn = FALSE AND plan.status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM device_token token WHERE token.user_id = user.user_id AND token.is_active = TRUE ) ORDER BY user.user_id LIMIT #{limit}
